identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: one after another, or concurrently?
identity.reason: Public pinned executable PME benchmark, published invocation and publicly accessible inputs; supplied brief provides fixed-work ensemble driver. No benchmark substitution.

outcome_definition.primary: Finish eight independent 25,000-step DHFR replicas sooner on one GPU while preserving each replica scientific outcome.
outcome_definition.scientific_output_limitation: Driver samples 100 potential energies per replica but persists only mean and final values; full series equality cannot be checked from its JSON alone.

citations.citation: Hsu, Clark and Paulsen (2025-06-04), NVIDIA Technical Blog

Equilibrated PDB and bundled force fields
source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.licence: Distributed with OpenMM; no separate file-specific licence verified during intake
source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.reason: Brief explicitly states local running and modification are permitted; repository licence checked. Separate file-level grant not independently established.
Driver supplied for this benchmark and brief explicitly permits local running and modification; no separate driver licence specified.

stock_cuda_image.reason: CUDA 12 wheels exist, but stock image identity, Python/glibc versions, GPU/driver compatibility and container MPS access are unspecified and untested.
stock_cuda_image.provisional_feasibility: Published installation route supports Linux x86_64, Python 3.10–3.13, CUDA-12-capable NVIDIA driver; no build or workload run.
stock_cuda_image.mps: Published optimization requires CUDA MPS; availability/permissions unknown. Sequential baseline does not require MPS.

data_plus_peak_working_set.reason: PDB verified in memory; force-field total size and peak host/device memory, especially eight concurrent contexts, not published or measured. Atom count alone insufficient.

scoring.performance: 0.8 simulated ns / total_wall_s * 86400 yields aggregate ns/day; speedup is sequential total_wall_s divided by candidate total_wall_s at identical fixed work.
scoring.reason: Brief predictions are hypotheses, not independently published acceptance criteria. No numeric energy targets or allowable differences established.
scoring.anchor_policy: Only independently published observation stored as reference with null tolerance; no reference-based pass/fail criterion.
scoring.scientific_comparison: Brief proposes exact same-seed energy equality; fallback compares deviation against measured sequential same-seed run-to-run variation, which has not been measured. No numeric fallback tolerance available.

repeatability.reason: Brief specifies seeds, deterministic CUDA force property and same GPU/software comparisons, but no repeat count or statistical scoring rule. Deterministic forces do not independently establish trajectory equality across concurrent execution. CPU smoke-test mentioned in brief is not a published anchor.

search_reason: No benchmark search performed; checked only sources named in supplied brief.

evidence_verification.pdb: HTTP retrieval succeeded; SHA-256 and 23,558 atom records independently verified without writing input file.
evidence_verification.script: Pinned source fetched and PME model/integrator inspected.
evidence_verification.post: Web fetch timed out; direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded and published command plus approximate throughput verified.
